title: Best Pattern Designers (2026): Seamless Patterns for Print
description: How to hire a pattern designer for fabric, packaging, wallpaper or products: seamless repeats, color, files, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Pattern designers create repeating designs for fabric, clothing, wrapping paper, packaging, wallpaper, phone cases and print-on-demand products. A good pattern repeats seamlessly with no visible joins and prints well at the right scale. Projects go wrong when the repeat has visible seams, colors do not match the print method, or the files are not set up for the manufacturer. This guide helps you get patterns ready for production.

faq.a: A tile that repeats in every direction without visible edges. When placed side by side, it forms one continuous design.

faq.q: Which file formats do I need?
faq.a: Often a vector file such as AI or SVG and a high-resolution tile as PNG or TIFF. Ask your printer for their preferred format.

faq.q: Can I sell products with the pattern?
faq.a: Only with a commercial license. Agree on exclusivity and whether the designer can sell the same pattern elsewhere.
Patterns can repeat in a simple grid or offset, such as a half-drop. Different repeats change how the pattern looks across a surface.

faq.q: Do colors print the same as on screen?
faq.a: Not always. Ask for color codes for your print method and order a sample print if possible.
